question: What diagnostic and partial-reuse behavior must be proven when an imported sidecar is rejected?
decision: Default source fallback remains authoritative for imported parse and type diagnostics, while independently valid lower dependency sidecars may remain reused when an importer sidecar is invalid.

diagnostic_contract.parse: preserve Parse error kind, canonical imported path, and source diagnostic text
diagnostic_contract.type: preserve Type error kind, canonical imported path, and source diagnostic text
diagnostic_contract.comparison: no-cache and malformed-cache return code, stdout, and stderr are identical

partial_reuse_contract.valid_lower_dependency: sidecar hit omits its private body
partial_reuse_contract.invalid_importer: source body remains available to the importer graph
partial_reuse_contract.repeated: cached output is deterministic across repeated builds

old_path_deletion_condition: Do not remove source fallback or dependency-body checking until the complete imported visibility and diagnostic inventory has zero unexplained parity differences.
